provenance.sourceDefinition: Sum of eligible ETH at stake on the Beacon Chain
provenance.upstreamProvider: Dune Analytics, as credited by ethereum.org
provenance.captureMethod: Fetched the public Ethereum.org staking page and parsed the unique visible server-rendered Total ETH staked card. Its explanatory tooltip in the page payload identifies the definition and upstream provider.
limitations: The page does not publish an epoch or metric as-of timestamp. capturedAt is the source-check time only.
This is the reported site figure; no independent validator-registry aggregation was performed.
No active-validator count is inferred and no validator-count-times-32 calculation is used.

sourceNote: Ethereum.org reports this total without a metric timestamp or epoch. Source-checked time is when the page was fetched, not an on-chain as-of time.
